mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that prompts central bank intervention, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has been above 5.5% for two consecutive months, or the signal's predictive power is not statistically significant (p-value > 0.05) in a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a flight to quality in equities and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: The negative return pattern fails when both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously in more than 50% of cases, and SPX 60-day returns are positive in over 55% of such instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p>0.05) in a 2-year regression.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over 20 days as higher interest rates reduce equity valuations and slow economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 6 months indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO has declined over the prior 6 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 950,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the residential sector that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST has been below 950 for two consecutive months, or the signal's predictive power is not significant (p>0.05) in a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over 20 days as the Federal Reserve is expected to implement accommodative monetary policy to stimulate the labor market.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal a tightening monetary policy and rising inflation, which together cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors fear stagflation.
failure_condition: The negative return pattern fails when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise simultaneously in more than 50% of cases, and SPX 5-day returns are positive in over 55% of such instances, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p>0.05) in a 2-year regression.
